title: Optimal estimation and goodness-of-fit testing of the mean for sparse longitudinal functional data
summary: We study the mean function of longitudinal functional data, where each subject contributes a small number of complete profiles over a general domain, observed at random visit times. The mean is projected onto an orthonormal basis in the time direction, and each coefficient function is estimated by a weighted average of the profiles. We consider deterministic and random weights, including closed-form, data-driven weights that dispense with the design density entirely.
